unsigned_reason: The board signer runs as OIDC inside GitHub Actions, disabled account-wide.
anchoring_is_not_signing: Anchoring proves WHEN bytes existed. Signing proves WHO attests to them. These artifacts are being anchored and are NOT signed; neither substitutes for the other.

stamp.state_meaning: A calendar has accepted this digest and promised future Bitcoin inclusion. This is NOT a Bitcoin attestation and must never be described as one. Run scripts/ots-upgrade.py in a few hours, then verify against the chain, before any file is called anchored.
